_doc: Compact head scanner (CHS) for the API source mode — dedicated head PET, wall = 2 X0 of BGO (X0 = 1.118 cm -> 2.236 cm; shared by BGO_195K and BGO_77K). Crystal inner radius 200 mm (patient bore ~30 cm after the cryostat; the ring slides over the head, lower edge at the shoulder line), 25 phi-blocks (50.3 mm arc) x 7 wheels (51.2 mm) -> axial 358.4 mm, vertex-to-C7 coverage. Same monolithic block technology and detector constants as crysp_ring_1m; only the ring changes. The phantom section is a PLACEHOLDER — in mode="api" the driver replaces it with the phantom built from the scenario's phantom_regions.csv. Dimensions in cm; material keys into data/materials.json.
